title: 2.7 On the seventh floor
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Say which floor someone lives on with sixth to tenth (I live on the seventh floor. / Where does Diego live? He lives on the seventh floor.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.7 Numbers 6-10: A1 counts six to ten; A1+ 2.7 adds the ordinal numbers sixth to tenth, in the order of A1+ 2.6's second to fifth (the seventh floor), about where people live (I live on the seventh floor.), with A1+ 1.9's Where does … live?. Each cast member stands by the elevator on the floor where they live, with the floor number on the wall: Ana on 6, Diego on 7, Luis on 8 and Sofia on 9; Diego's office (A1+ 2.1) is on 10.
prerequisite: A1 2.7 six to ten; A1+ 2.6 second to fifth; A1 4.15 floor; A1+ 1.4 lives in, aunt; A1+ 1.9 Where does … live?; A1+ 2.1 office.
speaking_outcome: Say sixth with x-th at the end, seventh with three syllables (SEV-en-th), eighth like eight + th, ninth with a long i, tenth with th at the end. Do not require native-like speed.
